game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the lava bridge.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Test dataset 1: {'a': 1, 'b': 3}; {'a': 0, 'b': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Eruption Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the lava bridge by solving code steps involving power_on that move the forge smith forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.25).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the lava bridge first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
